title: Three labelled money figures with tooltips: funds needed, margin needed, margin available (row 3 gap G-03-1)
reference_behaviour: A strip in the builder shows Funds Needed, Margin Needed and Margin Available, each with a definition tooltip; a negative margin needed is explained as a margin benefit to existing positions.
ours: One line Margin (Zerodha): Rs X needed, Rs Y available, no tooltips. Copy the labels and tooltips (REQ-081, REQ-136 AC-1); the reference's summed Funds Needed is inexact, so premium stays a separate engine line (money, ADR-152 (c)).
